title: The 14 Best Star Wars Games of All Time, Ranked
summary: Out of the many Star Wars games released over the years, these fantastic titles deserve your attention now and forever.
content: Star Wars video games date all the way back to The Empire Strikes Back on the Atari 2600 in 1982. Since then, the franchise itself has largely matured alongside the medium, encompassing everything from role-playing games and first-person shooters to arcade racers and XCOM clones (the latter of two seeing well-regard releases just this year). No matter the year or the hardware, some of the best Star Wars games are worth revisiting. Here are the 12 best Star Wars games of all time, ranked.

title: 7 Years Later, Hollywood’s Most Notorious Fantasy Flop Deserves Another Shot
summary: Seven years later, a first watch of Tom Hooper’s Cats on Netflix finds plenty to enjoy, especially Taylor Swift’s catnip number.
content: I vividly remember learning the phrase “uncanny valley” in 2019. First came the trailer for Sonic the Hedgehog that April, with those alarmingly human teeth. Then came the first trailer for Tom Hooper’s Cats in July. Suddenly, there was a name for a feeling I’d had my whole life. The uncanny valley is that uneasy feeling you get when something looks or moves almost like a real person, but some small detail makes the whole thing feel wrong. That feeling is a lot more common these days, now that AI-generated videos are everywhere. But it was Cats that really brought the uncanny valley into the popular lexicon.

title: JJ Abrams’ Sci-Fi Thriller Found-Footage Masterpiece Is Being Removed From Paramount Plus
summary: Matt Reeves’ found footage film Cloverfield is leaving
content: In some ways, the best found-footage movie ever made is still The Blair Witch Project . This wasn’t because of the film’s actual quality, but because of the effect it had on audiences back in 1999. When it was released, found-footage movies just weren't a well-known thing and the marketing campaign for the movie made it seem as though the events depicted actually happened. Since then, better found-footage movies have been made that have replay value — a quality The Blair Witch Project sorely lacks — but none since have ever tricked audiences quite so effectively.

title: Critical Role Officially Confirms a Fan-Favorite Episode Format Will Not Return
summary: Creative director of Critical Role Marisha Ray draws a crystal-clear line on what one-shot formats she doesn't want to revisit.
content: One of the best things about Critical Role ’s live shows is that, in many ways, they're a phenomenal way to address story threads the cast couldn’t get to by the end of the campaign. For example, The Mighty Nein Reunion: Echoes of the Solstice 2023 live show is set shortly after the Apogee Solstice, an event primarily associated with Campaign 3: Bells Hells but also directly affecting The Mighty Nein adventuring group, particularly Beauregard Lionett and Caleb Widogast.

title: Epic Games Store Officially Makes a Top Co-op Game Free for a Limited Time
summary: The Epic Games Store has a selection of free PC games that changes every week. The latest free offering will be available until Dec. 3.
content: Thanksgiving is today in the US, and what better way to spend time with your family and friends than by playing video games? For a limited time, the Epic Games Store has a great co-op PC game for free as well as free content for an idle RPG.

title: Spring Tokyo City region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
summary: The spring treasure hunt is located in the Tokyo City region of Forza Horizon 6. Here's its exact location and how to reach it.
content: The spring Tokyo City region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 7, "City Life." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.

title: Sorry Jason And Lucia, These 5 GTA 6 Side Characters Steal Every Scene They're In
summary: Jason and Lucia aren’t GTA 6's only great characters, as these 5 have really endeared themselves to Polygon’s writers
content: Although Jason and Lucia are the stars of Grand Theft Auto 6 and amazing characters in their own right, there are lots of side characters who steal the show whenever they show up. From folks critical to the main story path to weirdos you meet if you take the time to stop and chat with someone on the side of the road, GTA 6 constantly introduces wild, memorable characters almost every hour.

title: GTA: Boston Would Go Wicked Hard, Kid
summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a perfect Florida satire, and now I'm dying to see Rockstar's take on Massachusetts.
content: Considering that Grand Theft Auto 6 just launched after a 13-year wait, it’s safe to say that we won’t be getting another one any time soon. That’s fine, because Leonida is so enormous that I know I’ll still be finding secrets in it years from now. And yet, I can’t help myself. I’m already wondering where the series could possibly go next. Allow me to offer one unsolicited idea: Massachusetts.

title: The One Reason Nintendo and Rockstar Can Make Games Like Ocarina of Time and GTA 6
summary: GTA 6 and the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake are proof of the value of retaining talent long-term
content: Though wildly different in tone and scope, both Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto 6 and Nintendo’s remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time exemplify the craft of making video games at its finest. Each one is redolent with attention to detail. Whether it’s the achingly nostalgic aesthetic of Ocarina or Rockstar’s Borg-like hive-mind of interconnected gameplay systems, there is a staggering amount of talent and dedication on display in these games. There are the kinds of endeavors that take years to pull off — and a company dedicated to helping its employees learn and grow over time. These are not the sort of games that can be produced by a company that lays people off every six months.

title: Harrison Ford’s 10/10 Action Thriller Is Leaving Streaming Soon
summary: Air Force One is leaving Peacock on Nov. 30, 2026. Here’s why Harrison Ford’s classic action thriller is worth watching.
content: Harrison Ford has played plenty of memorable action heroes throughout his career, from Indiana Jones to Jack Ryan. But one of his most entertaining roles puts him in an especially unusual position: the Oval Office. In 1997's Air Force One , Ford plays a U.S. president who must take matters into his own hands when terrorists seize control of the plane carrying him and his family.

title: 32 Years Later, Disney's Most Notorious Cash-Grab Sequel Is Better Than You Remember
summary: The Aladdin sequel The Return of Jafar is often derided as a bad, cheap sequel which started Disney's direct-to-video sequel trend, but I love it
content: Ever since former Disney CEO Bob Chapek released his autobiography last September, a rather unexpected Disney movie has been a topic for discussion: the direct-to-VHS sequel to Aladdin titled The Return of Jafar . Released in 1994, The Return of Jafar was the first in a long line of direct-to-VHS (and later direct-to-DVD) sequels to theatrical Disney films. Besides Aladdin , Disney made sequels to The Lion King , The Little Mermaid , Pocahontas , Mulan , and several other then-modern Disney animated features, as well as some much older classics like Cinderella and Bambi . These movies used cheaper animation produced by Disney’s TV division and were developed in far less time than Disney spends developing animated feature films .

title: Prime Video Is Saying Goodbye to Six Decades of James Bond Movies
summary: Nearly every James Bond movie is leaving Prime Video on Nov. 30, including Casino Royale, GoldenEye, Skyfall, and No Time to Die.
content: James Bond fans looking to revisit the legendary spy's cinematic adventures might want to clear their schedules before the end of November. Prime Video is preparing to remove a huge chunk of the 007 franchise from its streaming library, with nearly every James Bond movie currently available on the platform scheduled to leave at the same time.

title: These Rare Pokémon Cards Are No Longer Eligible for PSA Grading
summary: PSA was forced to stop grading English-language Mega Hyper Rare Pokémon cards due to a manufacturing error.
content: Mega Evolution returned to the Pokémon Trading Card Game with the launch of the Mega Evolution series in 2025. In this expansion, collectors can find extremely rare Mega Evolution Pokémon EX cards known as Mega Hyper Rare cards in English and Mega Ultra Rare cards in Japanese. These holographic secret cards show alternative artwork of Pokémon's Mega Evolutions on a beautiful gold-etched display.

title: GTA 6 Developers Have Voted Against Unionization by 75% to 25%
summary: Rockstar Games workers have rejected a union deal with the IWGB as Grand Theft Auto 6 breaks records
content: Rockstar Games' UK workforce has voted firmly against unionization the week after the studio's latest game, Grand Theft Auto 6 , demolished sales records .

title: Star Trek: Voyager Officially Revisits the Series' Best Two-Parter in a Brand-New Way
summary: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown strategy game officially reveals Year of Hell DLC
content: One of the best two-episode arcs in Star Trek: Voyager , if not the entire Star Trek franchise, is the "Year of Hell" duology. The story from the show's fourth season pitted the crew of Voyager against a unique threat that tested their perseverance more than any previous enemy had.

title: 10 Years Later, Netflix's $120 Million Flop Deserves a Season 2
summary: The Get Down was peak Netflix
content: This Turkey Day , as Polygon celebrates our favorite failures and flops from the world of entertainment, it's time to resurrect a Netflix original that earned (mostly) rave reviews but got canceled after just one season for what, in hindsight, feels like an easily avoidable reason. Not only is The Get Down an overlooked masterpiece, but 10 years later, it's due for a revival.

title: The Sims 4 Officially Makes 13 DLCs Free for a Limited Time
summary: The Sims 4 is hosting a holiday giveaway that allows players to claim up to 13 free Maker Packs throughout the next eight weeks.
content: The Sims 4 has received a steady stream of content since it launched 12 years ago. However, 2026 has been particularly dry. The last major expansion, Royalty & Legacy , was released in February, and aside from kits, the game hasn't received much content this year. This may be because of the team's focus on Project Renee (which may be on hold) or because of internal matters related to Electronic Arts' private-equity buyout .
